{"action":"shell","command": "cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

# Test R06: direct insert between apply calls is visible
db4 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w4 = BatchWriter(db4)
w4.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'from_batch': True}}])
print(f'After batch insert: {db4.all()}')

# Simulate the _next_id issue
w4.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'from_batch2': True}}])
print(f'After second batch insert: {db4.all()}')

# Now direct insert
db4.insert({'from_direct': True})
all_docs = db4.all()
print(f'After direct insert: {all_docs}')
print(f'Count: {len(all_docs)}')

# Check what _next_id is
print(f'_next_id: {db4.table(\"_default\")._next_id}')
